en: Noen
Ada
Sheila
Pok
Red
Misha
These Curses Are Far Too Useful to Me
zh_TW: 這些詛咒對我太有用了

en: This Bottle Isn't the Cure
Get Pok to South Street
Get through the mist and take Pok to South Street
zh_TW: 穿過毒霧，把波克帶到南街

en: The healing stopped when you left the mist. Step back in to check
zh_TW: 離開毒霧，回血就停了。再踏回去確認一次

en: Follow Sheila
Defeat the guardian with Sheila
Try the Mist Serpent Venom (or keep it for later)
zh_TW: 試用霧蛇毒劑（也可以先收著）

en: Head for the freight lift to the underground market
Poisoned
Poisoned → Regenerating
[Poisoned]
[Reversal Constitution activated] Poisoned → Regenerating
zh_TW: 【逆轉體質已啟動】中毒 → 持續回血

en: TOXIC
The barrels split open. Green mist is creeping along the ground.
zh_TW: 藥桶裂開了。綠色的霧沿著地面流過來

en: Empty reversal slot
Mist Serpent Venom
Effect: Poisoned for 20 seconds. Label: NOT FOR DRINKING
zh_TW: 效果：中毒，持續 20 秒。瓶上寫：不可飲用

en: You're at full health, so you won't see any effect. Drink it anyway?
zh_TW: 現在滿血，看不出效果。還是要喝嗎？

en: Drink
Keep it for now
Press {key} — take the bottles
To be continued: the underground market
To be continued
The Underground Market
You got paid. Half of it, anyway.
Open the gate!
The monster's after the cargo.
Then take the man!
You still owe us our pay!
Noen. That can wait.
zh_TW: 諾恩，這句可以等一下再喊。

en: The warmth stopped when the mist thinned... Step back in. Just to be sure.
zh_TW: 霧散了，溫熱感也停了……再踏回去一次。確認一下就好。

en: It's real. Not just once.
...Are you all right?
I think today might not be that unlucky after all.
zh_TW: 我想，我今天可能沒那麼倒楣。

en: Who brought poison into a residential street?
The guy who just ran off!
Take the injured man inside! ...You too. Get in.
Don't hit its chest yet. That's where the poison sprays from.
zh_TW: 先別打牠胸口。那是噴毒的地方。

en: So?
(Step into the mist and show her the closing wound)
zh_TW: （走進毒霧，讓她看手上正在收口的傷）

en: "Poison heals me."
...You'd better explain this later.
Did that thing hit your head? ...Fine. Prove it while we fight.
zh_TW: 你被打昏頭了？……算了，邊打邊證明。

en: Its right knee. Take it down.
Name.
Noen.
Sheila. Hold still.
Ow. Gently.
If you're scared of pain, stop running into poison.
zh_TW: 會怕痛就別一直往毒裡跑。

en: Those are two different things.
Two sealed bottles left. "Mist Serpent Venom. Poisoned, 20 seconds."
zh_TW: 還有兩瓶封好的。「霧蛇毒劑：中毒，持續二十秒。」

en: Breathing it in worked. Would a sip be any different?
zh_TW: 剛才只是吸到霧。喝一點會不會不一樣？

en: What are you drinking?
Look here first.
So you're not immune to poison.
From what I can tell, poison helps me heal.
zh_TW: 目前看起來，毒會幫我恢復。

en: Any poison?
Don't know yet.
Then don't drink random things. You've checked this one. Get the others tested first.
zh_TW: 那就先別亂喝。這瓶你確認過，其他的先找人驗。

en: You're keeping that?
For when I'm actually hurt.
Fine. Anything else, get it tested first.
Red left this in my keeping. Pok says it's what he owed you.
zh_TW: 雷德寄存的。欠你們的那份，波克認出來了。

en: Money. Real money.
Only half. The broken crates, we'll settle later.
zh_TW: 只有一半。那些打壞的木箱之後算。

en: I didn't break them.
Which is why I'm going after the man who ran.
This batch was supposed to be destroyed. The report says monsters hit the shipment.
zh_TW: 這批藥應該已經銷毀了。報告上寫，運送途中遭怪物襲擊。

en: Red asked about the freight lift to the underground market this morning. They've been taking in loads of goods that can't pass certification.
zh_TW: 雷德早上問過地下市場的貨梯。那裡最近收一大批不能過認證的東西。

en: What kind of goods?
Poisonous ones. Ones that make your limbs stop listening. Ones that sap your strength. Nobody normal buys them.
zh_TW: 有毒的、會讓人手腳不聽話的、戴上就沒力氣的。正常客人不會買。

en: Don't make that face.
What face?
Like you're about to get a free meal.
Partners? You find evidence. I find my pay.
zh_TW: 合作嗎？妳找證據，我找工錢。

en: Deal. Bring your own drinks. Nothing goes in my canteen.
zh_TW: 可以。飲料自己帶，不准放進我的水壺。

en: Its poison heals you. Its claws and slams still hurt.
zh_TW: 牠噴的毒會讓你回血。爪子和下砸照樣會痛

en: Poison spray
The Shop's Least Welcome Customer
zh_TW: 藥店最不受歡迎的客人

en: Walk down into the underground market
Find the potion seller: the shop with the green window at the end of the street
zh_TW: 找賣藥的人：街底那間綠色窗戶的藥店

en: Go into the shop and put your hand on the test board
zh_TW: 走進藥店，把手放到測試板上

en: The freight lift goes down
Hold {key} — put your hand on the test board
zh_TW: 按住 {key}　把手放到測試板上

en: Nothing down here passed certification. There is one rule: the side effect goes on the tag. Every item, every tag.
zh_TW: 這裡賣的東西都沒通過認證。規矩只有一條：副作用要寫在吊牌上。每一件都要。

en: So the curses are labelled honestly. That is more than I can say for the bottles upstairs.
zh_TW: 所以詛咒都老實寫出來了。比上面那些貼著認證的瓶子還誠實。

en: Don't say that to Misha. Green window, end of the street. Ask her which poison lasts longest, and try not to sound like you are picking a fight.
zh_TW: 這句別對彌夏說。街底綠色窗戶那間。問她哪一種毒撐得最久，口氣別像是來找麻煩的。

en: Excuse me. Which poison lasts the longest? It is for me to drink.
zh_TW: 請問，哪一種毒可以撐久一點？我自己要喝的。

en: The door is behind you. I don't sell to people who want to die, or to people who want someone else to.
zh_TW: 門在你後面。想找死的、想害人的，我都不賣。

en: Neither. Being poisoned heals me. I only just found out.
zh_TW: 都不是。我中毒的時候會回血，剛剛才發現的。

en: I hear that three times a month, and I carried all three of them out. Put your hand on the test board. It gives you a very weak poison. When the needle swings to red, you pay for the antidote and go home.
zh_TW: 這句話我一個月聽三次，三個都是我抬出去的。手放到測試板上：它會下一點很弱的毒。指針往紅色那邊跑，你付解藥錢然後回家。

en: I hear that three times a month, and I carried all three of them out. Hold out your hand. You are not hurt at all, so there is nothing to measure. I will prick you first. Then put it on the test board. When the needle swings to red, you pay for the antidote and go home.
zh_TW: 這句話我一個月聽三次，三個都是我抬出去的。手伸出來——你一點傷都沒有，測不出東西，我先扎一針。然後手放到測試板上：指針往紅色那邊跑，你付解藥錢然後回家。

en: ...The needle went to green. The board is not broken. I calibrated it last month.
zh_TW: ……指針往綠色那邊跑了。板子沒壞，我上個月才校正過。

en: So can I buy something now?
No. My poisons are dosed for people who do not want to be poisoned. Not one of them was made for drinking. What you want has to be mixed from scratch.
zh_TW: 不行。我賣的毒是算好劑量、給不想中毒的人防身用的，沒有一瓶是做來喝的。你要的東西得重新調。

en: That sounds like a yes.
zh_TW: 聽起來是願意調的意思。

en: It means I want to know what else you can do. Someone at the black-market demo is selling a bracer that paralyzes whoever wears it. He says his medicine fixes the side effect. Go and see whether that is true. Then we talk prices.
zh_TW: 是「我要先知道你還會什麼」的意思。黑市示範場今天有人在賣一種戴了會麻痺的護腕，說副作用吃他的藥就會好。你去看看是不是真的，回來我們再談價錢。

en: Bracer Seller
The Black-Market Demo
Go to the black-market demo: the stage halfway up the street
zh_TW: 去黑市示範場：街中段搭著台子的地方

en: Stop the demo: deal with the guards
zh_TW: 打斷示範：解決示範場的守衛

en: Step up and look. The speed bracer. Strap it on and your hand moves twice as fast. My man will show you.
zh_TW: 各位看好：高速護腕。戴上去，出手快一倍。我的人示範給你們看。

en: Yes, wear it a while and the arm goes numb. It is on the tag. I hide nothing. But one bottle of my antidote, forty coins, and the paralysis is gone.
zh_TW: 對，戴久了手會麻、會動不了，牌子上寫了，我沒騙人。不過配我的解藥，一瓶四十枚，麻痺馬上消。

en: The bracer is fifteen coins. The antidote is forty, and you need one every time you wear it. He is not selling bracers. He is selling antidote.
zh_TW: 護腕十五枚，解藥四十枚，而且每戴一次就要喝一瓶。他賣的不是護腕，是解藥。

en: The side effect is on the tag. By the rules down here, he has done nothing wrong.
zh_TW: 牌子上有寫副作用。照這裡的規矩，他沒犯規。

en: The tag says it may go numb now and then. The man on the stage has not moved his left hand once since he stepped up.
zh_TW: 牌子上寫「偶爾會麻」。台上那個人從上台到現在，左手一次都沒動過。

en: ...What do you want me to do?
Ask him to show it again, without the antidote. He will say no, and the guards will come over first.
zh_TW: 請他再示範一次，不准喝解藥。他不會答應，守衛會先走過來。

en: That part I can do.
Demo Guard
Bracer Guard
Club swing
Club thrust
Fast punch (his arm goes numb after)
Show it again. No antidote this time.
zh_TW: 再示範一次。這次不准喝解藥。

en: The guard with the bracers hits fast, but his arm goes numb after every punch. Hit him while he is stuck.
zh_TW: 戴護腕的守衛出手很快，但每打一拳手就會麻。趁他僵住的時候打。

en: Trying the Bracer
Stop! Stop hitting them! Take it. Take the bracer and go!
zh_TW: 別打了！別打了！拿去，護腕給你，快走！

en: He hit fast. But after every punch his arm just hung there. That is the real side effect.
zh_TW: 他出拳很快。可是每打一拳，手就垂在那裡動不了。這才是真正的副作用。

en: Everyone here saw it. He will not sell another one today.
zh_TW: 在場的人都看到了。他今天一個也賣不出去。

en: Do not put that on. Your arm will go numb too.
zh_TW: 那個你別戴。你的手也會麻。

en: Poison heals me. I want to know what paralysis turns into. I will try it at Misha's shop, where it is safe.
zh_TW: 毒會讓我回血。我想知道麻痺會變成什麼。回彌夏的店裡試，那裡安全。

en: Paralyzed
Paralyzed → Faster attacks
[Paralyzed]
[Second reversal slot] Paralyzed → Faster attacks
zh_TW: 【第二格反轉】麻痺 → 出手加速

en: Hold {key} — put the hand with the bracer on the test board
zh_TW: 按住 {key}　把戴著護腕的手放到測試板上

en: Trying the Bracer
Go back to Misha's shop: test the bracer on her board first
zh_TW: 回彌夏的店：先在測試板上試護腕

en: Put the hand with the bracer on the test board
zh_TW: 把戴著護腕的手放到測試板上

en: Two Slots at Once
You brought that thing into my shop? Even the man selling it will not wear it.
zh_TW: 你把那個東西帶進我店裡？賣它的人自己都不敢戴。

en: Poison heals me. I want to know what paralysis turns into.
zh_TW: 毒會讓我回血。我想知道麻痺會變成什麼。

en: Fine. My rules: put it on, then put that hand on the test board. If the board says danger, you take it off at once.
zh_TW: 可以。照我的規矩：先戴上，再把那隻手放到測試板上。板子說危險，你就馬上拿下來。

en: All right. You watch the needle. I will watch my hand.
zh_TW: 好。妳看指針，我看我的手。

en: The needle swung to red, then flipped all the way to green. And your arm did not drop.
zh_TW: 指針先甩到紅的那邊，然後整個翻到綠的那邊。你的手也沒有垂下來。

en: It is not numb. It is faster. On me, paralysis turns into speed.
zh_TW: 不但沒麻，手還變快了。麻痺在我身上會變成加速。

en: Poison heals you. Paralysis speeds you up. That is two slots. I want to see both at once.
zh_TW: 中毒回血，麻痺加速。你有兩格了。兩格一起用是什麼樣子，我也想看。

en: Then I need somewhere to try it. Only a real fight will tell.
zh_TW: 那就找個地方試。真的打一場才知道。
